# MESH_NETWORK

A mesh control plane, addressed from inside the cluster running it and from outside.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `mesh`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.mesh`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
